questions.stem:
Mr Chan, aged 42, is the sole breadwinner of his family. He wishes to ensure his wife and two children can maintain their living expenses if he dies prematurely. Which category of life insurance need does this primarily reflect?
陳先生42歲，是家庭唯一收入來源，希望若自己早逝，妻子及兩名子女仍可維持生活開支。這主要反映哪一類人壽保險需要？
stemLines: Mr Chan, aged 42, is the sole breadwinner of his family. He wishes to ensure his wife and two children can maintain their living expenses if he dies prematurely. Which category of life insurance need does this primarily reflect?
陳先生42歲，是家庭唯一收入來源，希望若自己早逝，妻子及兩名子女仍可維持生活開支。這主要反映哪一類人壽保險需要？

options.text:
Personal need — maintaining dependants' living expenses
個人需要——維持受養人生活開支

Business need — key person protection
業務需要——關鍵人物保障

Personal need — emergency fund only
個人需要——僅作應急資金

Business need — employee benefits
業務需要——僱員福利

questions.explanation: 教材將「受養人生活開支」列為典型個人需要，目的在收入提供者死亡後以保險金替代其未來收入。關鍵人物、合夥安排及僱員福利屬業務需要，與本題家庭保障情境不符。

questions.stem:
In a life insurance contract, Ms Lee pays premiums, owns the policy and may change the beneficiary. Mr Wong's life is covered under the policy. Ms Cheung is named to receive the death benefit. Which pairing is correct?
在人壽保險合約中，李女士繳付保費、擁有保單並可更改受益人；黃先生的生命受保；張女士獲指定收取死亡保險金。以下哪一配對正確？
stemLines: In a life insurance contract, Ms Lee pays premiums, owns the policy and may change the beneficiary. Mr Wong's life is covered under the policy. Ms Cheung is named to receive the death benefit. Which pairing is correct?
在人壽保險合約中，李女士繳付保費、擁有保單並可更改受益人；黃先生的生命受保；張女士獲指定收取死亡保險金。以下哪一配對正確？

options.text:
Policyowner: Mr Wong; Insured: Ms Lee; Beneficiary: Ms Cheung
保單所有人：黃先生；受保人：李女士；受益人：張女士

Policyowner: Ms Lee; Insured: Mr Wong; Beneficiary: Ms Cheung
保單所有人：李女士；受保人：黃先生；受益人：張女士

Policyowner: Ms Cheung; Insured: Mr Wong; Beneficiary: Ms Lee
保單所有人：張女士；受保人：黃先生；受益人：李女士

Policyowner: Ms Lee; Insured: Ms Cheung; Beneficiary: Mr Wong
保單所有人：李女士；受保人：張女士；受益人：黃先生

questions.explanation: 保單所有人（Policyowner）擁有合約權利並通常負責繳費；受保人（Insured）是其生命受保的人；受益人（Beneficiary）收取死亡保險金。四個身分可由不同人士擔任，不能因某人為受保人便假定其必然擁有保單或收取保險金。

questions.stem:
Which statement best describes how the six insurance principles apply to traditional life insurance?
以下哪一項最能描述六項保險原則對傳統人壽保險的適用？
stemLines: Which statement best describes how the six insurance principles apply to traditional life insurance?
以下哪一項最能描述六項保險原則對傳統人壽保險的適用？

options.text:
Indemnity applies but Insurable Interest does not
彌償適用但可保權益不適用

All six principles apply in the same way as property insurance
六項原則均與財產保險相同方式適用

Insurable Interest and Utmost Good Faith apply; Indemnity, Contribution and Subrogation generally do not
可保權益及最高誠信適用；彌償、分擔及代位權一般不適用

Contribution and Subrogation apply but Utmost Good Faith does not
分擔及代位權適用但最高誠信不適用

questions.explanation: 人壽保險屬利益保單，一般不適用彌償、分擔及代位權；但可保權益及最高誠信仍必須適用。近因在一般死亡保障較少爭議，但在意外附約等情況仍可能重要。

questions.stem:
A policyholder asks whether he may collect benefits from three separate life policies on his own life if he dies. Under standard life insurance principles, which is correct?
保單持有人問若自己死亡，能否同時從三份以自己生命為標的的人壽保單收取利益。按標準人壽保險原則，以下哪項正確？
stemLines: A policyholder asks whether he may collect benefits from three separate life policies on his own life if he dies. Under standard life insurance principles, which is correct?
保單持有人問若自己死亡，能否同時從三份以自己生命為標的的人壽保單收取利益。按標準人壽保險原則，以下哪項正確？

options.text:
No, because Indemnity requires total recovery not to exceed the loss
不可以，因為彌償要求總賠償不得超過損失

No, because Utmost Good Faith prohibits multiple policies
不可以，因為最高誠信禁止多份保單

Yes, but only if Subrogation is waived in writing
可以，但必須書面放棄代位權

Yes, because Contribution does not generally apply to life insurance
可以，因為分擔（Contribution）一般不適用於人壽保險

questions.explanation: 人壽保險通常按約定金額支付，屬利益保單而非彌償保單，因此分擔及代位權一般不適用，可同時從多份人壽保單收取約定利益。最高誠信要求披露重要事實，但並不禁止持有或索償多份保單。

questions.stem:
A bank lends HK$2,000,000 to Mr Ho and requires life insurance on his life for the loan amount. Mr Ho later asks whether his adult brother may take out a policy on his life without proving any financial relationship. Which is correct?
銀行借出200萬港元予何先生，並要求就其生命投保相等於貸款額度的保險。何先生其後問，其成年兄長能否在不證明任何金錢關係下為其生命投保。以下哪項正確？
stemLines: A bank lends HK$2,000,000 to Mr Ho and requires life insurance on his life for the loan amount. Mr Ho later asks whether his adult brother may take out a policy on his life without proving any financial relationship. Which is correct?
銀行借出200萬港元予何先生，並要求就其生命投保相等於貸款額度的保險。何先生其後問，其成年兄長能否在不證明任何金錢關係下為其生命投保。以下哪項正確？

options.text:
Both the bank and the brother automatically have Insurable Interest as family members
銀行及兄長作為家庭成員均自動擁有可保權益

The brother has Insurable Interest but the bank does not
兄長有可保權益但銀行沒有

The bank as creditor has Insurable Interest; the brother does not automatically have Insurable Interest
銀行作為債權人有可保權益；兄長不會自動擁有可保權益

Neither has Insurable Interest because the loan is secured
兩者均無可保權益，因為貸款有抵押

questions.explanation: 債權人對債務人的生命可有可保權益；血緣或一般家庭關係本身不一定自動構成可保權益，必須符合法定關係或證明金錢利益。債務人不會單因欠款而對債權人的生命有同等權益。

questions.stem:
Before applying for life insurance, Ms Tam had chest pain investigated two years ago but did not mention it on the application because she felt fully recovered. The insurer later discovers the records. Which principle is most directly engaged?
投保前，谭女士曾因胸痛接受检查但自觉已康复，故在投保单上没有披露。保险人其后发现相关记录。最直接涉及哪一项原则？
stemLines: Before applying for life insurance, Ms Tam had chest pain investigated two years ago but did not mention it on the application because she felt fully recovered. The insurer later discovers the records. Which principle is most directly engaged?
投保前，谭女士曾因胸痛接受检查但自觉已康复，故在投保单上没有披露。保险人其后发现相关记录。最直接涉及哪一项原则？

options.text:
Proximate Cause
近因

Utmost Good Faith — duty to disclose Material Facts
最高诚信——披露重要事实（Material Facts）的责任

Indemnity
弥偿

Contribution
分担

questions.explanation: 最高诚信要求投保人披露会影响审慎保险人承保决定的重要事实。判断重点不是投保人主观认为资料是否重要，而是该资料会否影响审慎保险人的判断。健康症状及既往病史均可能属重要事实，安排验身不会自动解除披露责任。

questions.stem:
An actuary explains that premium rates must be sufficient to pay benefits and expenses while remaining fair among similar risks. These two pricing standards are known as:
精算師解釋，保費率必須足以支付利益及開支，同時對相若風險保持公平。這兩項定價標準稱為：
stemLines: An actuary explains that premium rates must be sufficient to pay benefits and expenses while remaining fair among similar risks. These two pricing standards are known as:
精算師解釋，保費率必須足以支付利益及開支，同時對相若風險保持公平。這兩項定價標準稱為：

options.text:
Natural and Level
自然及均衡

Participating and Non-Participating
分紅及不分紅

Adequate and Equitable/Fair
充足（Adequate）及公平（Equitable/Fair）

Gross and Net
毛保費及淨保費

questions.explanation: 传统定价两项标准是：保费必须充足（Adequate），足以支付利益、开支并维持偿付能力；同时必须公平（Equitable/Fair），使相若风险承担相若成本。自然/均衡保费属保费制度，分红/不分红及毛/净保费属不同分类。

questions.stem:
Which formula correctly states the relationship among gross premium, net premium and loading?
以下哪一條算式正確表達毛保費、淨保費與附加保費的關係？
stemLines: Which formula correctly states the relationship among gross premium, net premium and loading?
以下哪一條算式正確表達毛保費、淨保費與附加保費的關係？

options.text:
Gross Premium = Net Premium − Loading
毛保費 = 淨保費 − 附加保費

Net Premium = Gross Premium + Loading
淨保費 = 毛保費 + 附加保費

Loading = Net Premium − Gross Premium
附加保費 = 淨保費 − 毛保費

Gross Premium = Net Premium + Loading
毛保費 = 淨保費／純保險費 + 附加保費

questions.explanation: 净保费／纯保险费由死亡率与利息假设计算，用以应付预期保障成本；附加保费用来支付行政、销售及营运开支。毛保费（Gross Premium）= 净保费／纯保险费 + 附加保费。

questions.stem:
A start-up technology firm insures its chief software architect because his death would severely disrupt product development and client contracts. This need is best classified as:
一家初創科技公司為其首席軟件架構師投保，因其死亡會嚴重打擊產品開發及客戶合約。此需要最好歸類為：
stemLines: A start-up technology firm insures its chief software architect because his death would severely disrupt product development and client contracts. This need is best classified as:
一家初創科技公司為其首席軟件架構師投保，因其死亡會嚴重打擊產品開發及客戶合約。此需要最好歸類為：

options.text:
Personal need — retirement income
個人需要——退休收入

Business need — key person protection
業務需要——關鍵人物（Key Persons）保障

Personal need — mortgage redemption
個人需要——按揭贖回

Business need — partnership buy-out only
業務需要——僅屬合夥權益買斷

questions.explanation: 补偿关键人物死亡对盈利、营运及替补成本的影响，属典型业务需要。退休收入、按揭赎回属个人需要；本题焦点是营运依赖关键员工，而非单纯合伙安排。

questions.stem:
Which statement about modern life insurance in Hong Kong is correct?
關於香港現代人壽保險，以下哪項正確？
stemLines: Which statement about modern life insurance in Hong Kong is correct?
關於香港現代人壽保險，以下哪項正確？

options.text:
It only pays a death benefit and cannot include savings or investment features
只支付死亡保險金，不能包含儲蓄或投資功能

The Insured must always be the Policyowner
受保人必須同時是保單所有人

Beneficiaries must always be the Insured's spouse
受益人必須是受保人的配偶

It may combine death protection, savings, investment and retirement planning
可結合死亡保障、儲蓄、投資及退休策劃

questions.explanation: 现代人寿保险除基本死亡保障外，亦可兼具储蓄、投资及退休策划功能。香港人寿市场多采用美式保单用语。保单所有人、受保人及受益人可由不同人士担任。

questions.stem:
Under life insurance, why is Indemnity generally not applicable?
在人壽保險下，為何彌償（Indemnity）一般不適用？
stemLines: Under life insurance, why is Indemnity generally not applicable?
在人壽保險下，為何彌償（Indemnity）一般不適用？

options.text:
Because Utmost Good Faith removes the need for Indemnity
因為最高誠信使彌償變得不需要

Because Insurable Interest expires at claim
因為可保權益在索償時失效

Because human life cannot be measured precisely in monetary terms
因為人的生命不能以精確金錢衡量

Because life policies are always short-term
因為人壽保單永遠是短期

questions.explanation: 弥偿旨在把受保人回复至损失前的财务状况，不容许获利。人的生命不能以精确金钱衡量，所以人寿保险通常按约定金额支付，属利益保单而非弥偿保单。

questions.stem:
Mr and Mrs Lau took out a life policy on their 16-year-old son's life five years ago when he was a minor. The son is now 21. Which statement about Insurable Interest is correct?
劉先生夫婦在五年前兒子16歲時為其生命投保。兒子現已21歲。關於可保權益，以下哪項正確？
stemLines: Mr and Mrs Lau took out a life policy on their 16-year-old son's life five years ago when he was a minor. The son is now 21. Which statement about Insurable Interest is correct?
劉先生夫婦在五年前兒子16歲時為其生命投保。兒子現已21歲。關於可保權益，以下哪項正確？

options.text:
Insurable Interest must still exist at death or the claim fails
死亡時仍須存在可保權益，否則不能索償

Insurable Interest is never required for life insurance on children
為子女投保從不需要可保權益

Insurable Interest was required at inception; it need not exist at death
合約開始時須存在可保權益；受保人死亡時毋須再次存在

Insurable Interest only matters if the Policyowner changes
只有保單所有人變更時才需要考慮可保權益

questions.explanation: 可保权益只在合约开始时需要，受保人死亡时毋须再次存在。父母与未满18岁子女属常见法定可保权益基础；欠缺可保权益下订立的合约无效。

questions.stem:
An applicant declares "good health" but omits that he scuba-dives competitively every month. The insurer would have charged extra premium if this had been disclosed. The omitted activity is most likely a:
申请人声明「健康良好」，但没有披露每月参与竞技潜水。若已披露，保险人会收取额外保费。被遗漏的活动最可能属于：
stemLines: An applicant declares "good health" but omits that he scuba-dives competitively every month. The insurer would have charged extra premium if this had been disclosed. The omitted activity is most likely a:
申请人声明「健康良好」，但没有披露每月参与竞技潜水。若已披露，保险人会收取额外保费。被遗漏的活动最可能属于：

options.text:
Immaterial fact because no claim has occurred
非重要事实，因为尚未发生索偿

Material Fact affecting a prudent insurer's decision
会影响审慎保险人决定的重要事实

Public fact that the insurer must discover itself
保险人须自行发现的公开事实

Fact that medical examination automatically discloses
验身会自动披露的事实

questions.explanation: 危险嗜好及职业均可能构成重要事实。即使保险人可安排验身，也不会自动解除投保人的披露责任。重要事实的标准是会否影响审慎保险人是否承保或以何种保费、条款承保。

questions.stem:
Which pricing element would most directly increase the pure insurance cost when expected deaths rise?
當預期死亡上升時，哪一項定價元素最直接提高純保險成本？
stemLines: Which pricing element would most directly increase the pure insurance cost when expected deaths rise?
當預期死亡上升時，哪一項定價元素最直接提高純保險成本？

options.text:
Interest
利息（Interest）

Expenses only
僅開支

Mortality
死亡率（Mortality）

Grace Period
寬限期

questions.explanation: 死亡率是定价核心元素之一：预期死亡越高，保障成本越高，通常以死亡表为资料基础。利息假设上升一般会降低所需保费；开支形成附加保费但与死亡率变动无直接对应。

questions.stem:
A participating policy may declare a cash dividend at anniversary. A non-participating policy differs mainly because it:
分紅保單（Participating/Par）可於周年宣派現金紅利；不分紅保單（Non-Participating/Non-Par）的主要分別在於：
stemLines: A participating policy may declare a cash dividend at anniversary. A non-participating policy differs mainly because it:
分紅保單（Participating/Par）可於周年宣派現金紅利；不分紅保單（Non-Participating/Non-Par）的主要分別在於：

options.text:
Cannot provide any death benefit
不能提供任何死亡保險金

Must use natural premium pricing only
必須只採用自然保費制度

Is illegal in Hong Kong
在香港屬非法

Has no cash dividend from the insurer's surplus
不會從保險人盈餘宣派現金紅利

questions.explanation: 美式分红保单可宣派现金红利；不分红保单没有现金红利。英式有利润保单通常派发复归红利。红利并非保证利益，除非保单另有明确规定。

questions.stem:
Who bears the risk under the contract and promises to pay the death benefit?
在合約下誰承擔風險並承諾支付死亡保險金？
stemLines: Who bears the risk under the contract and promises to pay the death benefit?
在合約下誰承擔風險並承諾支付死亡保險金？

options.text:
Policyowner
保單所有人（Policyowner）

Beneficiary
受益人（Beneficiary）

Assignee
承讓人（Assignee）

Insurer
保險人（Insurer）

questions.explanation: 保险人承担风险并按合约支付死亡保险金。保单所有人拥有合约权利并通常负责缴费；受益人收取保险金；承让人在转让后享有相应权利，但不承担保险人角色。

questions.stem:
After the insurer pays a life insurance death benefit, can it normally pursue a third party who caused the death and take over the beneficiary's right of recovery?
保險人支付人壽死亡保險金後，能否通常向導致死亡的第三者追討並取代受益人的追討權？
stemLines: After the insurer pays a life insurance death benefit, can it normally pursue a third party who caused the death and take over the beneficiary's right of recovery?
保險人支付人壽死亡保險金後，能否通常向導致死亡的第三者追討並取代受益人的追討權？

options.text:
Yes, because Subrogation always applies
可以，因為代位權永遠適用

Only if Indemnity has been applied first
只有先適用彌償才可以

No, because Subrogation generally does not apply to life insurance
不可以，因為代位權（Subrogation）一般不適用於人壽保險

Only for policies above HK$1 million
只有保額超過100萬港元才可以

questions.explanation: 代位权是弥偿的引伸原则，因人寿保险一般不适用弥偿，故代位权也一般不适用。保险人支付人寿利益后，不会因支付而取得受益人对第三者的追讨权。

questions.stem:
Which combination correctly matches life insurance with three principles that generally do NOT apply?
以下哪一組正確配對人壽保險與三項一般不適用原則？
stemLines: Which combination correctly matches life insurance with three principles that generally do NOT apply?
以下哪一組正確配對人壽保險與三項一般不適用原則？

options.text:
Life insurance — Insurable Interest, Utmost Good Faith, Proximate Cause
人壽保險——可保權益、最高誠信、近因

Property insurance — Insurable Interest only
財產保險——僅可保權益

Life insurance — Indemnity, Contribution, Subrogation
人壽保險——彌償、分擔、代位權

Life insurance — Adequate, Equitable, Mortality
人壽保險——充足、公平、死亡率

questions.explanation: 教材明确：可保权益适用；Indemnity、Contribution、Subrogation 一般不适用于人寿保险。近因在一般死亡保障较少争议，但在意外附约等情况下仍可能重要。

questions.stem:
A creditor's life policy on a debtor's life becomes invalid if the debt is fully repaid before the insured dies. Is this statement correct regarding Insurable Interest?
若債務在受保人死亡前已全數清還，債權人就債務人生命所投的保單會因可保權益消失而無效。此說法是否正確？
stemLines: A creditor's life policy on a debtor's life becomes invalid if the debt is fully repaid before the insured dies. Is this statement correct regarding Insurable Interest?
若債務在受保人死亡前已全數清還，債權人就債務人生命所投的保單會因可保權益消失而無效。此說法是否正確？

options.text:
Correct — Insurable Interest must exist throughout the policy term
正確——可保權益必須整個保單期內存在

Correct — the policy automatically transfers to the debtor
正確——保單會自動轉給債務人

Incorrect — Insurable Interest is only required at inception, not at death
不正確——可保權益只在合約開始時需要，死亡時毋須再次存在

Incorrect — repayment creates Insurable Interest for the debtor
不正確——還款會為債務人建立可保權益

questions.explanation: 可保权益只在合约开始时需要。即使债务后来清还，只要开始时存在合法可保权益，合约不会因死亡时已无债务而当然无效。欠缺可保权益下订立的合约方属无效。

questions.stem:
Under the natural premium pricing system, what problem may arise as insureds grow older?
在自然保費制度（Natural Premium Pricing System）下，隨受保人年齡增長可能出現什麼問題？
stemLines: Under the natural premium pricing system, what problem may arise as insureds grow older?
在自然保費制度（Natural Premium Pricing System）下，隨受保人年齡增長可能出現什麼問題？

options.text:
Premiums fall and anti-selection disappears
保費下降且逆選擇消失

Premiums rise; healthier lives may lapse, causing anti-selection
保費上升；較健康者可能退保，形成逆選擇（Anti-Selection）

Cash value grows faster than under level premium
現金價值比均衡保費制度增長更快

Mortality assumptions become irrelevant
死亡率假設變得無關

questions.explanation: 自然保费随到达年龄及死亡率逐年增加，年长时保费可能难以负担，健康较佳者可能先退出，形成逆选择。均衡保费制度则在约定期内维持平稳保费，早期差额累积成现金价值。

questions.stem:
In level premium pricing, early-year premiums exceed the current cost of death protection. The excess mainly:
在均衡保費制度（Level Premium System）下，早期保費高於當期死亡成本，差額主要：
stemLines: In level premium pricing, early-year premiums exceed the current cost of death protection. The excess mainly:
在均衡保費制度（Level Premium System）下，早期保費高於當期死亡成本，差額主要：

options.text:
Is refunded in cash every year
每年以現金退還

Accumulates as cash value to subsidise later higher mortality cost
累積成現金價值，以補貼後期較高死亡成本

Is paid to the beneficiary immediately
即時支付給受益人

Reduces the sum insured automatically
自動降低保額

questions.explanation: 均衡保费在约定期内维持平稳；早期保费高于当期死亡成本，差额累积成现金价值；后期则用累积额补贴较高的死亡成本。现金价值可支持保单抵押贷款、不能作废选择及缴清保险等。

questions.stem:
Two equal partners in an accounting firm buy life policies on each other so the surviving partner can purchase the deceased partner's share. This illustrates which business need?
兩名合夥相若的會計師事務所合夥人互相為對方生命投保，以便在一名合夥人死亡後，生存者可購入其權益。這體現哪一項業務需要？
stemLines: Two equal partners in an accounting firm buy life policies on each other so the surviving partner can purchase the deceased partner's share. This illustrates which business need?
兩名合夥相若的會計師事務所合夥人互相為對方生命投保，以便在一名合夥人死亡後，生存者可購入其權益。這體現哪一項業務需要？

options.text:
Employee benefits
僱員福利

Partnership arrangement
合夥人（Partnerships）安排

Personal retirement planning only
僅屬個人退休策劃

Mortgage redemption
按揭贖回

questions.explanation: 为已故合伙人的权益买断及业务延续提供资金，属合伙人业务需要。雇员福利针对一般员工；退休策划及按揭赎回属个人需要范畴。

questions.stem:
Early life insurance policies were often short-term and addressed temporary risks. Modern policies differ because they may also provide:
早期人壽保單多為短期並只處理暫時性風險。現代人壽保單的不同之處在於亦可能提供：
stemLines: Early life insurance policies were often short-term and addressed temporary risks. Modern policies differ because they may also provide:
早期人壽保單多為短期並只處理暫時性風險。現代人壽保單的不同之處在於亦可能提供：

options.text:
Savings, investment and retirement planning features
儲蓄、投資及退休策劃功能

No death benefit at all
完全沒有死亡保險金

Automatic property damage cover
自動財產損壞保障

Only group cover without individual policies
只有團體保障而沒有個人保單

questions.explanation: 人寿保险最初及最基本目的是在受保人死亡时支付保险金；早期保单多属短期。现代人寿保险则兼具死亡保障、储蓄、投资及退休策划等功能。

questions.stem:
A student states: "Life insurance claim payments are always limited to the exact financial loss suffered." Which principle shows this statement is wrong?
有學生說：「人壽保險索償永遠只限於實際蒙受的確切財務損失。」哪一項原則顯示此說法錯誤？
stemLines: A student states: "Life insurance claim payments are always limited to the exact financial loss suffered." Which principle shows this statement is wrong?
有學生說：「人壽保險索償永遠只限於實際蒙受的確切財務損失。」哪一項原則顯示此說法錯誤？

options.text:
Insurable Interest must exist at death
可保權益必須在死亡時存在

Utmost Good Faith removes fixed benefits
最高誠信會取消固定利益

Indemnity does not generally apply to life insurance
彌償一般不適用於人壽保險

Contribution requires equal sharing
分擔要求平均分攤

questions.explanation: 人寿保险通常按约定金额支付，属利益保单，一般不适用弥偿原则。因此索偿不必局限于可量化的财务损失，亦不会因多份保单而按弥偿方式分摊。

questions.stem:
Which principle requires the proposer to disclose health history, hazardous hobbies and prior insurance arrangements that would influence a prudent insurer?
哪一項原則要求投保人披露會影響審慎保險人的健康狀況、危險嗜好及過往投保安排？
stemLines: Which principle requires the proposer to disclose health history, hazardous hobbies and prior insurance arrangements that would influence a prudent insurer?
哪一項原則要求投保人披露會影響審慎保險人的健康狀況、危險嗜好及過往投保安排？

options.text:
Utmost Good Faith
最高誠信（Utmost Good Faith）

Subrogation
代位權

Contribution
分擔

Natural premium pricing
自然保費定價

questions.explanation: 最高诚信要求披露重要事实，包括健康、职业、危险嗜好及相关投保资料。近因、分担及代位权与披露责任无直接对应；自然保费属定价制度。

stemLines: A stranger proposes insuring an unrelated neighbour's life for HK$5,000,000 with himself as beneficiary, without any financial tie. Under Hong Kong law, the contract is most likely:
一名陌生人在沒有任何金錢關係下，提議為無關鄰居的生命投保500萬港元並自己為受益人。按香港法例，該合約最可能：

只有一年有效期

questions.explanation: 《保险业条例》规定，在欠缺可保权益下订立的人寿保险合约无效；规则目的是防止把陌生人的生命变成投机或赌博工具。不能透过事后转让等方法规避此规定。

questions.stem:
Which of the following is LEAST likely to be treated as a Material Fact in life insurance underwriting?
以下哪一項最不可能在人壽保險核保中被視為重要事實？
stemLines: Which of the following is LEAST likely to be treated as a Material Fact in life insurance underwriting?
以下哪一項最不可能在人壽保險核保中被視為重要事實？

options.text:
Undisclosed heart disease
未披露的心臟病

Occupation as a commercial pilot
商用機師職業

Regular mountaineering without disclosure
未披露的定期攀山活動

Favourite colour of the applicant's car
申請人汽車最喜愛的顏色

questions.explanation: 重要事實包括健康狀況、既往病史、職業、危險嗜好及投保資料等，會影響審慎保險人是否承保或如何定價。汽車顏色與風險及承保決定無關，最不可能構成重要事實。

questions.stem:

stemLines: Higher expected investment returns on premium reserves will, other things equal, tend to:
在其他因素不變下，保費準備金較高預期投資回報一般會：

options.text:
Increase required premium
提高所需保費

Reduce required premium
降低所需保費

Eliminate the need for loading
消除附加保費需要

Remove mortality from pricing
從定價中移除死亡率

questions.explanation: 利息（Interest）是定价元素：预期投资收入越高，所需保费通常越低，因投资收益可补贴部分保障成本。死亡率及开支仍须纳入定价；附加保费不会因投资回报而完全消失。

questions.stem:
Cash value built up under a level premium whole life policy is best described as:
均衡保費終身壽險累積的現金價值最好描述為：
stemLines: Cash value built up under a level premium whole life policy is best described as:
均衡保費終身壽險累積的現金價值最好描述為：

options.text:
An extra benefit completely separate from the death sum insured
完全獨立於死亡保額之外的額外利益

Part of the policy's internal reserve mechanism, not a free extra payment on top of full death benefit without adjustment
保單內部準備金機制的一部分，並非在按條款處理貸款及費用前可無條件額外於全額死亡保險金之外領取的免費利益

Payable only if the insured dies accidentally
只在意外死亡時才支付

Guaranteed equal to all premiums paid with no deductions ever
保證等於所有已繳保費且永無扣除

questions.explanation: 现金价值来自早期较高保费与当期死亡成本的差额累积，可支持保单贷款及不能作废选择。实际支付须按保单条款处理未偿贷款、退保费用等；并非无条件额外于死亡保险金之上的独立免费利益。

questions.stem:
A company provides group life and medical cover to staff as part of its remuneration package. This is an example of:

stemLines: A company provides group life and medical cover to staff as part of its remuneration package. This is an example of:
公司以团体人寿及医疗保障作为薪酬福利一部分，例子属于：

options.text:
Business need — employee benefits
业务需要——雇员福利（Employee Benefits）

Personal need — disability income only
个人需要——仅残疾收入

Personal need — final expenses only
个人需要——仅善终开支

Business need — key person only
业务需要——仅关键人物

questions.explanation: 以团体保障吸引、挽留及保障雇员，属雇员福利业务需要。残疾收入及善终开支可为个人需要内容，但本题描述的是雇主提供的团体福利计划。

questions.stem:
In Hong Kong, life insurance policy terminology most commonly follows which market tradition?
在香港，人壽保單用語最常見跟隨哪種市場傳統？
stemLines: In Hong Kong, life insurance policy terminology most commonly follows which market tradition?
在香港，人壽保單用語最常見跟隨哪種市場傳統？

options.text:
American/North American usage
美國／北美用法

Strictly British usage only with no variation
嚴格只用英式用法且全無變化

Marine insurance terminology exclusively
只用海上保險用語

MPF scheme terminology
強積金計劃用語

questions.explanation: 教材指出香港人寿保险市场多采用美国及北美常见保单用语；一般保险市场则较常采用英式用语。因此阅读条款时应注意人寿与 general insurance 的术语差异。

questions.stem:

近因（Proximate Cause）在評估以下哪類人壽索償時尤其相關？
stemLines: Proximate Cause is especially relevant to life insurance when assessing claims under:
近因（Proximate Cause）在評估以下哪類人壽索償時尤其相關？

options.text:
A standard whole life death claim from natural illness with no exclusions
沒有除外責任下因自然疾病的一般終身壽險死亡索償

An Accidental Death Benefit rider where death must result from accident
須證明死亡由意外導致的意外死亡保險利益附約

A premium receipt before policy issue
保單簽發前的保費收據

A dividend declaration on a participating policy
分紅保單的紅利宣派

questions.explanation: 一般人寿保险甚少就死亡原因争议，但自杀免责期及意外死亡附约是重要例外。意外附约须确认意外是否为近因，且死亡通常须在意外后指定期限内发生。

questions.stem:
Insurable Interest in life insurance must exist at which point?
人壽保險的可保權益（Insurable Interest）必須在何時存在？
stemLines: Insurable Interest in life insurance must exist at which point?
人壽保險的可保權益（Insurable Interest）必須在何時存在？

options.text:
Only at policy inception
只在合約開始時

At inception and again at every premium renewal
開始時及每次續保時

Only when a claim is paid
只在支付索償時

Only when the beneficiary is changed
只在更改受益人時

questions.explanation: 可保权益只在合约开始时需要；受保人死亡时毋须再次存在。欠缺可保权益下订立的合约无效；不能假定血緣关系本身自动构成可保权益。

questions.stem:
A guardian insures the life of a 15-year-old ward. Which Insurable Interest basis most directly supports this arrangement?

stemLines: A guardian insures the life of a 15-year-old ward. Which Insurable Interest basis most directly supports this arrangement?
監護人為15歲被監護人生命投保。哪一項可保權益基礎最直接支持此安排？

options.text:
Guardian and ward under 18
監護人與未滿18歲被監護人

Any neighbour relationship
任何鄰居關係

Former employer and retired employee with no financial link
無金錢聯繫的前僱主與退休僱員

Debtor insuring creditor's life
債務人為債權人生命投保

questions.explanation: 常見法定可保權益包括監護人與未滿18歲被監護人、父母與未滿18歲子女、配偶及自己生命等。債權人可保債務人生命，但反向通常不成立；一般鄰居關係不足以構成。

questions.stem:

options.text:
Material Fact is best defined as information that:
重要事实（Material Fact）的最佳定义是：
A The applicant personally believes is important
申请人个人认为重要的资料

Would influence a prudent insurer's decision to accept, rate or terms
会影响审慎保险人决定是否承保、如何定价或条款的资料

Appears only on the medical report
只出现在医疗报告上的资料

Must be known only after a claim occurs
只在索偿发生后才知道的资料

questions.explanation: 重要事实的判断标准是会否影响审慎保险人的承保决定，而非投保人主观看法。健康、职业、嗜好及投保记录均可能重要；披露责任在投保时已经存在。

questions.stem:
Which pricing factor reflects administrative, sales and operating costs added to the pure premium?

哪一項定價因素反映加於純保費之上的行政、銷售及營運成本？

options.text:
Expenses / loading
開支／附加保費

Mortality only
僅死亡率

Interest only
僅利息

Beneficiary designation
受益人指定

questions.explanation: 开支（Expenses）形成附加保费，涵盖行政、销售及营运成本。死亡率与利息用于计算净保费／纯保险费；受益人指定与定价计算无直接关系。

questions.stem:
A with-profit policy in the British tradition most commonly distributes surplus through:

stemLines: A with-profit policy in the British tradition most commonly distributes surplus through:
英式有利潤保單（With-Profit）最常透過以下哪種方式分配盈餘？

options.text:
Reversionary Bonus paid with policy benefits
復歸紅利（Reversionary Bonus），一般在支付保單利益時一併支付

Daily cash rebates to unrelated third parties
向無關第三者每日現金回扣

Automatic cancellation of the policy at age 40
在40歲自動取消保單

Subrogation recoveries from at-fault drivers
向過失駕駛者行使代位權追討

questions.explanation: 英式有利润保单通常派发复归红利，一般在支付保单利益时一并支付；无利润保单（Without-Profit）没有红利。美式分红保单则可宣派现金红利。红利并非保证，除非保单另有规定。

questions.stem:

stemLines: Saving for children's university fees through a long-term life policy primarily meets which need?
透过长期人寿保单为子女大学学费储蓄，主要满足哪一类需要？

options.text:
Personal need — education funding

Business need — key person
业务需要——关键人物

Business need — partnership
业务需要——合伙安排

Personal need — employee benefits
个人需要——雇员福利

questions.explanation: 为子女或受养人预留教育资金属个人需要。关键人物、合伙及雇员福利均围绕商业营运而非家庭 education planning。

questions.stem:

stemLines: The Beneficiary's primary role is to:

Receive the death benefit as designated by the Policyowner
按保单所有人指定收取死亡保险金

Underwrite the risk at application
在投保时核保风险

Set mortality tables for pricing
制定死亡表作定价

questions.explanation: 受益人是保单所有人指定收取死亡保险金的人，通常须在受保人死亡时仍生存。缴费一般是保单所有人责任；核保及定价属保险人职能。

questions.stem:
Which statement about Contribution in life insurance is correct?
關於人壽保險中的分擔（Contribution），以下哪項正確？
stemLines: Which statement about Contribution in life insurance is correct?
關於人壽保險中的分擔（Contribution），以下哪項正確？

options.text:
Multiple life policies on the same life may pay full contractual benefits without Contribution adjustment
同一生命的多份人壽保單可按合約全額支付，無需分擔調整

Only one life policy may ever pay on the same life
同一生命永遠只能由一份保單賠償

questions.explanation: 分擔是彌償的引伸原則，人壽保險一般不適用，故可同時從多份人壽保單收取約定利益。人壽保險不是彌償合約，因此毋須按損失比例在各保單間分攤。

questions.stem:
Traditional life insurance is described as a "benefit policy" mainly because:
傳統人壽保險被稱為「利益保單」主要是因為：
stemLines: Traditional life insurance is described as a "benefit policy" mainly because:
傳統人壽保險被稱為「利益保單」主要是因為：

options.text:
It pays a contractual sum rather than measuring precise financial loss
按合約金額支付，而非精確衡量財務損失

It never pays any benefit on death
死亡時永不支付任何利益

It requires no Utmost Good Faith
不需要最高誠信

It always excludes suicide permanently
永遠永久除外自殺

questions.explanation: 因人的生命不能以精确金钱衡量，人寿保险通常按约定金额支付，属利益保单，一般不适用弥偿。最高诚信及可保权益仍然适用；自杀通常只在初期免责期内除外。

questions.stem:
Attempting to arrange a policy through a person with Insurable Interest and then pre-arrange assignment to someone without Insurable Interest is:
試圖由有可保權益的人投保，再預先安排轉讓予無可保權益的人：
stemLines: Attempting to arrange a policy through a person with Insurable Interest and then pre-arrange assignment to someone without Insurable Interest is:
試圖由有可保權益的人投保，再預先安排轉讓予無可保權益的人：

options.text:
Acceptable if disclosed after one year
若一年後披露即可接受

Potentially invalid if the overall arrangement evades the law
若整體安排實質規避法例，仍可能無效

Always recommended for estate planning
永遠是遺產策劃建議做法

Required for all business policies
所有商業保單均必須如此

questions.explanation: 不能透过先由有权益人士投保、再预先安排转让予无权益人士的方法绕过规定；若整体安排实质是规避法例，仍可能无效。可保权益只在开始时需要，但规避行为本身仍受挑战。

questions.stem:
When deciding if a fact is Material, the test focuses on:
判斷事實是否重要時，測試重點是：
stemLines: When deciding if a fact is Material, the test focuses on:
判斷事實是否重要時，測試重點是：

options.text:
Whether a prudent insurer would have acted differently if informed
審慎保險人若獲知該資料會否作出不同決定

Whether the agent thinks the question is polite to ask
中介人是否認為問題禮貌

Whether the fact was published in a newspaper
事實是否曾在報章刊登

Whether the policy has a cash value
保單是否有現金價值

questions.explanation: 重要事实的标准是会影响审慎保险人是否承保、保费或条款，而非社交礼貌、传媒报道或保单是否有现金价值。健康及职业资料常属重要事实。

questions.stem:
Anti-selection under natural premium pricing occurs mainly because:
自然保費制度下的逆選擇主要因為：
stemLines: Anti-selection under natural premium pricing occurs mainly because:
自然保費制度下的逆選擇主要因為：

options.text:
Younger insureds always receive dividends
年輕受保人永遠獲得紅利

Rising premiums cause healthier lives to leave, leaving worse risks in the pool
保費上升使較健康者離開，較差風險留於風險組合

Insurable Interest disappears each year
可保權益每年消失

Subrogation applies to every claim
每筆索償均適用代位權

questions.explanation: 自然保费随年龄上升，年长时可能难以负担，健康较佳者可能先退出，留下风险较高者，形成逆选择。均衡保费制度以长期平稳保费及现金价值机制减轻此问题。

questions.stem:
Which pair correctly lists two core components used to calculate net premium?
以下哪一對正確列出計算淨保費的兩項核心組成部分？
stemLines: Which pair correctly lists two core components used to calculate net premium?
以下哪一對正確列出計算淨保費的兩項核心組成部分？

options.text:
Mortality and Interest assumptions
死亡率及利息假設

Grace period and reinstatement fee
寬限期及復效費

Beneficiary and assignee names
受益人及承讓人姓名

Cooling-off period and twisting
冷靜期及誘導轉保

questions.explanation: 净保费／纯保险费由死亡率与利息假设计算，用以应付预期保障成本。宽限期、复效、受益人及冷静期属保单行政或销售规管，不是净保费精算核心。

questions.stem:
Building retirement cash flow through annuity or savings components within life planning addresses which need?
透过年金或储蓄成分建立退休现金流，属于哪一类需要？
stemLines: Building retirement cash flow through annuity or savings components within life planning addresses which need?
透过年金或储蓄成分建立退休现金流，属于哪一类需要？

options.text:
Personal need — retirement income
个人需要——退休收入

Business need — employee benefits only
业务需要——仅雇员福利

Business need — key person only
业务需要——仅关键人物

Personal need — credit life only
个人需要——仅信用寿险

questions.explanation: 透过储蓄、投资或年金安排建立退休现金流，属个人退休需要。信用寿险及雇员福利分别对应债务保障与雇主福利；关键人物属业务需要。

questions.stem:
Which description of the original and basic purpose of life insurance is most accurate?
以下哪一項對人壽保險最初及最基本目的描述最準確？
stemLines: Which description of the original and basic purpose of life insurance is most accurate?
以下哪一項對人壽保險最初及最基本目的描述最準確？

options.text:
Pay a sum of money to help dependants when the insured dies while the policy is in effect
於受保人在保單有效期間死亡時支付一筆金錢，以幫助受養人

Guarantee investment returns regardless of mortality
不論死亡率均保證投資回報

Replace fire and theft cover for household property
取代家居財產的火險及盜竊保障

Provide daily hospital cash only with no death cover
只提供每日住院現金而沒有任何死亡保障

questions.explanation: 人寿保险最初及最基本目的是在受保人死亡时，由保险人按合约向指定收款人支付死亡保险金，协助家人应付失去收入等需要。现代人寿产品虽可附加储蓄及投资，但基本目的仍是死亡保障。

questions.stem:
Which of the following insurance principles MUST apply to a standard Hong Kong life insurance contract?
下列哪一項保險原則必須適用於標準香港人壽保險合約？
stemLines: Which of the following insurance principles MUST apply to a standard Hong Kong life insurance contract?
下列哪一項保險原則必須適用於標準香港人壽保險合約？

options.text:
Indemnity
彌償（Indemnity）

Contribution
分擔（Contribution）

Subrogation
代位權（Subrogation）

Insurable Interest
可保權益（Insurable Interest）

questions.explanation: 人壽保險必須適用可保權益及最高誠信；彌償、分擔及代位權一般不適用於人壽保險，因人壽保險屬利益保單而非彌償保單。

questions.stem:
Under the life insurance principles overview, which statement about Indemnity is correct?
就人壽保險原則總覽而言，下列有關彌償的陳述哪項正確？
stemLines: Under the life insurance principles overview, which statement about Indemnity is correct?
就人壽保險原則總覽而言，下列有關彌償的陳述哪項正確？

options.text:
Life insurance must restore the insured to the exact pre-loss financial position
人壽保險須把受保人回復至損失前的精確財務狀況

Indemnity generally does not apply to life insurance
彌償一般不適用於人壽保險

Beneficiaries may only recover actual economic loss suffered
受益人只可追討實際蒙受的經濟損失

Multiple life policies must share one death benefit under Contribution
多份人壽保單須按分擔原則分享一份死亡保險金

questions.explanation: 人壽保險按約定金額支付利益，屬利益保單；彌償旨在回復至損失前財務狀況並不容許獲利，因此一般不適用於人壽保險。

questions.stem:
Mr Chan insured his business partner's life five years ago when a genuine financial interest existed. That interest ended two years ago. The partner dies today. Which statement is correct regarding Insurable Interest?
陳先生五年前在存在真正金錢利益時為其生意合夥人投保。該利益已於兩年前終結。合夥人今日身故。就可保權益而言，下列哪項正確？
stemLines: Mr Chan insured his business partner's life five years ago when a genuine financial interest existed. That interest ended two years ago. The partner dies today. Which statement is correct regarding Insurable Interest?
陳先生五年前在存在真正金錢利益時為其生意合夥人投保。該利益已於兩年前終結。合夥人今日身故。就可保權益而言，下列哪項正確？

options.text:
The contract is void because interest no longer exists at death
合約無效，因為身故時已不存在可保權益

The contract was void ab initio as partnership interest is uncertain
合約自始無效，因合夥利益不確定

The contract remains valid if interest existed at inception
若合約開始時存在可保權益，合約仍然有效

Interest must be re-established annually for the policy to stay valid
保單須每年重新確立可保權益方屬有效

questions.explanation: 可保權益只須在合約開始時存在；受保人死亡時毋須再次存在。欠缺可保權益下訂立的合約始屬無效。

questions.stem:
An applicant deliberately omits a recent cardiac diagnosis on the proposal form. The insurer would have charged a substandard premium had it known. This undisclosed fact is best described as:
投保人在投保單上故意隱瞞近期心臟診斷。若保險人知悉，本會收取次標準保費。此未披露資料最準確的描述是：
stemLines: An applicant deliberately omits a recent cardiac diagnosis on the proposal form. The insurer would have charged a substandard premium had it known. This undisclosed fact is best described as:
投保人在投保單上故意隱瞞近期心臟診斷。若保險人知悉，本會收取次標準保費。此未披露資料最準確的描述是：

options.text:
A warranty breach only affecting riders
只影響附約的保證違反

A minor detail because a medical exam was arranged
屬次要資料，因已安排驗身

Irrelevant unless the insurer asks in writing
除非保險人書面查詢，否則並不重要

A material fact affecting a prudent insurer's decision
會影響審慎保險人決定的重要事實

questions.explanation: 重要事實是會影響審慎保險人決定是否承保或以何種保費、條款承保的資料；判斷重點在於資料對審慎保險人的影響，而非投保人主觀認為是否重要。

questions.stem:
Traditional life insurance premium pricing is built on net premium plus loading for expenses. The net premium is primarily calculated from:
傳統人壽保險保費定價以淨保費加開支附加保費組成。淨保費主要由下列哪項計算？
stemLines: Traditional life insurance premium pricing is built on net premium plus loading for expenses. The net premium is primarily calculated from:
傳統人壽保險保費定價以淨保費加開支附加保費組成。淨保費主要由下列哪項計算？

options.text:
Mortality and interest assumptions
死亡率及利息假設

Sales commission targets only
只按銷售佣金目標

Policy loan interest rates
保單抵押貸款利率

Dividend declaration history
紅利宣派紀錄

questions.explanation: 淨保費／純保險費由死亡率與利息假設計算，用以應付預期保障成本；附加保費支付開支。毛保費＝淨保費＋附加保費。

questions.stem:
A pricing actuary states premiums must be both 'adequate' and 'equitable'. In this context, 'equitable' chiefly means:
精算師指保費須同時「充足」及「公平」。在此語境下，「公平」主要指：
stemLines: A pricing actuary states premiums must be both 'adequate' and 'equitable'. In this context, 'equitable' chiefly means:
精算師指保費須同時「充足」及「公平」。在此語境下，「公平」主要指：

options.text:
Every policyholder pays identical premiums regardless of risk
所有保單持有人不論風險均繳相同保費

Similar risks should bear similar costs
相若風險承擔相若成本

Premiums must always be the lowest in the market
保費必須永遠是市場最低

Only mutual insurers may use equitable pricing
只有相互保險公司才可採用公平定價

questions.explanation: 傳統定價要求保費充足以支付利益及維持償付能力，同時公平，使相若風險承擔相若成本。

questions.stem:
A listed company buys life cover on its chief financial officer to fund recruitment and profit disruption costs if she dies. This need is classified as:
一間上市公司為其財務總監購買人壽保險，以便在其身故時應付招聘及盈利中斷成本。此需要屬於：
stemLines: A listed company buys life cover on its chief financial officer to fund recruitment and profit disruption costs if she dies. This need is classified as:
一間上市公司為其財務總監購買人壽保險，以便在其身故時應付招聘及盈利中斷成本。此需要屬於：

options.text:
Personal mortgage redemption need
個人按揭贖回需要

Personal education funding need
個人教育經費需要

Business key person need
業務關鍵人物需要

Personal emergency fund need
個人應急資金需要

questions.explanation: 關鍵人物保障屬業務需要，用以補償關鍵人物死亡對盈利、營運及替補成本的影響；教育、按揭及應急資金屬個人需要。

questions.stem:
After paying a life insurance death benefit, the insurer seeks to recover from a negligent third party on behalf of the beneficiary. Subrogation in life insurance:
保險人支付人壽死亡保險金後，代表受益人向疏忽的第三者追討。就人壽保險中的代位權而言：
stemLines: After paying a life insurance death benefit, the insurer seeks to recover from a negligent third party on behalf of the beneficiary. Subrogation in life insurance:
保險人支付人壽死亡保險金後，代表受益人向疏忽的第三者追討。就人壽保險中的代位權而言：

options.text:
Automatically applies to all death claims
自動適用於所有死亡索償

Generally does not apply
一般不適用

Requires beneficiary consent only for term policies
只有定期壽險才須受益人同意

Transfers only half of recovery rights to the insurer
只把一半追討權轉移予保險人

questions.explanation: 代位權是彌償的引伸原則，一般不適用於人壽保險；保險人不因支付人壽利益而取得受益人對第三者的追討權。

questions.stem:
A creditor insures a debtor's life for the outstanding loan amount. Which statement about Insurable Interest is correct?
債權人為債務人的生命投保，保額相當於未償貸款。下列有關可保權益的陳述哪項正確？
stemLines: A creditor insures a debtor's life for the outstanding loan amount. Which statement about Insurable Interest is correct?
債權人為債務人的生命投保，保額相當於未償貸款。下列有關可保權益的陳述哪項正確？

options.text:
The debtor automatically has equal interest in the creditor's life
債務人自動對債權人的生命享有同等權益

Blood relationship alone always creates interest
單純血緣關係必然構成可保權益

The creditor may have insurable interest based on monetary loss
債權人可基於金錢利益而享有可保權益

Interest must still exist at the insured's death or the claim fails
受保人死亡時仍須存在可保權益，否則不能索償

questions.explanation: 債權人對債務人的生命可有可保權益；債務人不會單因欠款而對債權人的生命有同等權益。可保權益只在合約開始時需要。

questions.stem:
During underwriting, the insurer requests a medical examination. Under Utmost Good Faith, the applicant:
核保期間，保險人要求受保人驗身。在最高誠信下，投保人：
stemLines: During underwriting, the insurer requests a medical examination. Under Utmost Good Faith, the applicant:
核保期間，保險人要求受保人驗身。在最高誠信下，投保人：

options.text:
Is relieved from disclosing health facts once an exam is ordered
一旦安排驗身，即無須再披露健康資料

May rely on the agent to decide what is material
可倚賴代理人決定何謂重要事實

Must disclose material facts and may ask why the exam is required
仍須披露重要事實，並有權了解要求驗身的原因

Need only disclose facts he personally considers important
只需披露其個人認為重要的資料

questions.explanation: 即使保險人安排驗身，也不會自動解除投保人的披露責任；若要求身體檢查，投保人有權了解被要求檢查的原因及結果。

questions.stem:
Gross Premium in traditional life pricing equals:
傳統人壽保險定價中的毛保費（Gross Premium）等於：
stemLines: Gross Premium in traditional life pricing equals:
傳統人壽保險定價中的毛保費（Gross Premium）等於：

options.text:
Net premium plus expense loading
淨保費加開支附加保費

Mortality rate multiplied by sum insured only
只按死亡率乘以保額

Declared dividend plus cash value
已宣派紅利加現金價值

Interest earned minus policy loans
所得利息減保單貸款

questions.explanation: 毛保費＝淨保費／純保險費＋附加保費；淨保費由死亡率與利息假設計算，附加保費支付行政、銷售及營運成本。

questions.stem:
If expected investment income rises while other assumptions stay constant, the net premium component of a life policy will generally:
若預期投資收入上升而其他假設不變，人壽保單的淨保費部分一般會：
stemLines: If expected investment income rises while other assumptions stay constant, the net premium component of a life policy will generally:
若預期投資收入上升而其他假設不變，人壽保單的淨保費部分一般會：

options.text:
Increase because mortality rises
因死亡率上升而增加

Decrease because interest offsets mortality cost
因利息抵銷部分死亡成本而下降

Remain unchanged as interest is not a pricing factor
維持不變，因利息不是定價因素

Double under the natural premium system only
只在自然保費制度下才會加倍

questions.explanation: 利息是定價元素之一；預期投資收入越高，所需保費通常越低，因利息假設可抵銷部分由死亡率引致的保障成本。

questions.stem:
Which of the following is a personal rather than a business life insurance need?
下列哪項屬於個人而非業務上的人壽保險需要？
stemLines: Which of the following is a personal rather than a business life insurance need?
下列哪項屬於個人而非業務上的人壽保險需要？

options.text:
Funding a buy-out of a deceased partner's share
為已故合夥人權益買斷提供資金

Employee group term cover as a staff benefit
作為僱員福利的團體定期保障

Repaying an outstanding home mortgage on death
身故時清償未償住宅按揭

Protecting corporate debt covenants tied to an owner
保障與東主相關的公司債務契約

questions.explanation: 償還按揭、家庭生活、教育及退休收入屬個人需要；關鍵人物、合夥人權益買斷及僱員福利屬業務需要。

questions.stem:
In Hong Kong life insurance practice, contract wording often follows US/North American terms, whereas general insurance more commonly uses:
香港人壽保險市場的合約用語，較常採用下列哪一種風格？
stemLines: In Hong Kong life insurance practice, contract wording often follows US/North American terms, whereas general insurance more commonly uses:
香港人壽保險市場的合約用語，較常採用下列哪一種風格？

options.text:
Mainland PRC statutory wording only
只採用內地法定用語

European civil code terms exclusively
只採歐洲民法用語

British/European general insurance style for life policies
人壽保單完全採英式一般保險用語

US and North American policy terminology
美國及北美常見的保單用語

questions.explanation: 香港人壽保險市場多採用美國及北美常見的保單用語；一般保險市場則較常採英式用語。

questions.stem:
Proximate Cause is especially important under a life policy when:
在下列哪種情況下，近因（Proximate Cause）對人壽保單特別重要？
stemLines: Proximate Cause is especially important under a life policy when:
在下列哪種情況下，近因（Proximate Cause）對人壽保單特別重要？

options.text:
An Accidental Death Benefit rider is invoked
援引意外死亡保險利益附約

A pure whole life policy pays a standard death claim
純終身壽險支付標準死亡索償

Cash value is surrendered during lifetime
在生前退保收取現金價值

A dividend is applied to pay future premium
以紅利抵繳未來保費

questions.explanation: 一般人壽死亡保障較少爭議死亡原因，但意外死亡附約須確認意外是否死亡的近因；自殺免責期亦是重要例外。

questions.stem:
Which pairing correctly matches a life insurance principle with its typical application?
下列哪一組配對正確反映人壽保險原則及其一般適用方式？
stemLines: Which pairing correctly matches a life insurance principle with its typical application?
下列哪一組配對正確反映人壽保險原則及其一般適用方式？

options.text:
Indemnity — must apply at every death claim
彌償——每宗死亡索償均須適用

Utmost Good Faith — material facts must be disclosed
最高誠信——重要事實須如實披露

Contribution — limits payment to one policy only
分擔——只限一份保單作出賠付

Subrogation — insurer always sues third parties
代位權——保險人必定向第三者起訴

questions.explanation: 最高誠信要求披露重要事實；可保權益必須適用；彌償、分擔及代位權一般不適用於人壽保險。

questions.stem:
A policyowner assigns a life policy to a friend who had no insurable interest at inception, as part of a scheme to circumvent the law. The arrangement is likely:
保單所有人把在開始時無可保權益的朋友納入預先安排的轉讓，以規避法例。該安排很可能：
stemLines: A policyowner assigns a life policy to a friend who had no insurable interest at inception, as part of a scheme to circumvent the law. The arrangement is likely:
保單所有人把在開始時無可保權益的朋友納入預先安排的轉讓，以規避法例。該安排很可能：

options.text:
Valid if the friend pays future premiums

All past premiums are refunded without adjustment

questions.explanation: 萬用壽險的靈活不等於免費或無限制；若繳費不足、利息下降或扣費上升，現金價值可能耗盡而使保單失效。

stemLines: Life insurance underwriting focuses on mortality, whereas annuity underwriting focuses on:
人壽保險核保以死亡率為基礎，而年金核保則側重於：

options.text:
Survival/longevity — expected longer life increases payout periods
生存率——預期壽命越長，須支付的期數越多

Vehicle usage patterns
車輛使用模式

Fire peril at the insured's home
受保人住宅的火險

Marine cargo theft frequency
海上貨物盜竊頻率

questions.explanation: 年金核保以生存率為基礎：預期活得越久，須支付的期數越多；相同資本下，開始收取年金的年齡越高，每期利益通常越高。

stemLines: Under annuity structure, the Annuitant is:
在年金結構中，年金標的人（Annuitant）是指：

options.text:
Always identical to the insurer's actuary
永遠等同保險人的精算師

The person whose survival typically determines payment duration
其生存期通常決定年金支付期長短的人

The reinsurer sharing mortality risk
分擔死亡率風險的再保險人

The hospital providing long-term care
提供長期護理的醫院

questions.explanation: 年金是年金購買人向保險人繳付代價，由保險人在年金標的人生前或約定期限内向收款人周期支付；合約持有人、年金標的人及收款人可以是不同人士。

The insurer

The group policyholder (e.g. employer)

Each insured employee individually

The trade union treasurer only

questions.explanation: 團體保險由保險人向團體保單持有人簽發總團體保險合約；成員取得保險憑證／登記卡，而非各自持有總合約。

HKD 8,000

questions.stem:
Compared with whole life and endowment policies, term insurance is generally characterised by:

stemLines: Compared with whole life and endowment policies, term insurance is generally characterised by:

options.text:
The lowest premium for a given sum insured
A 相同保額下保費最低

Guaranteed cash values from year one

Mandatory participating dividends
C 強制分紅

A maturity benefit if the insured survives
D 受保人生存至期滿時的期滿利益

questions.explanation: 定期壽險純保障性強、通常無現金價值、保費在相同保額下最低；期滿生存一般不獲給付。

questions.stem:
Which product pays the death benefit only if the insured dies within a stated period while the policy remains in force?

哪種產品僅在受保人於指定期間內死亡且保單仍有效時支付死亡利益？

options.text:
Term insurance
A 定期壽險

Whole life insurance
B 終身壽險

Immediate annuity
C 即期年金

Pure endowment only
D 純生存保險

questions.explanation: 定期壽險只在特定期間提供保障；死亡須發生於指定期內且保單有效。終身壽險保障至任何時候死亡。

questions.stem:
A key feature of Universal Life Insurance is:

stemLines: A key feature of Universal Life Insurance is:
萬用壽險的一項主要特色是：

options.text:
Bundled pricing with no separate cost disclosure
A 保費與成本捆綁而毋須分項列示

Guaranteed fixed death benefit regardless of account value
B 不論帳戶價值均保證固定身故賠償

No need to monitor premium adequacy
C 毋須監察保費是否充足

Unbundled pricing showing insurance cost, expenses and interest separately
D 分別列示保險成本、開支及利息的非捆綁定價

questions.explanation: 萬用壽險特色包括靈活保費、可調整保額及非捆綁定價；年報會說明扣費、利息及現金價值變動。

questions.stem:
Life insurance underwriting mainly uses mortality assumptions, whereas annuity underwriting mainly uses:

stemLines: Life insurance underwriting mainly uses mortality assumptions, whereas annuity underwriting mainly uses:
人壽保險核保主要依據死亡率假設，而年金核保主要依據：

options.text:
Fire loss experience
A 火險損失經驗

Moral hazard surveys only
B 僅道德危險調查

Motor accident frequency
C 汽車意外頻率

Longevity / survival assumptions
D 長壽／生存率假設

questions.explanation: 壽險預期越早死亡成本越高；年金預期活得越久須支付期數越多，故以生存率為基礎。

questions.stem:
In an annuity contract, which statement is correct?
就年金合約而言，下列哪項描述正確？
stemLines: In an annuity contract, which statement is correct?
就年金合約而言，下列哪項描述正確？

options.text:
Contract holder, annuitant and payee must always be the same person
A 合約持有人、年金標的人及收款人必須是同一人

Only the insurer may receive annuity payments
B 只有保險人可收取年金

Annuity payments must be made in a single lump sum
C 年金必須一次過整筆支付

Contract holder, annuitant and payee may be different persons
D 合約持有人、年金標的人及收款人可以是不同人士

questions.explanation: 年金合約中合約持有人、年金標的人及收款人可由不同人士擔任，須按合約條款釐定。

questions.stem:
A Contributory group plan means:
供款式團體計劃是指：

options.text:
Contributory group plan means:
供款式團體計劃是指：
A Employees pay the entire premium alone
A 僱員獨自負擔全部保費

Employer and insured employees share premium payments
B 僱主與受保僱員共同分擔保費

The insurer contributes dividends to employees
C 保險人向僱員供款分紅

Only retirees may join
D 只有退休人士可加入

questions.explanation: 「供款式」指僱主及受保僱員雙方供款，並非僱員單獨付款；非供款式則由僱主全數負擔。

questions.stem:

下列哪項關於終身壽險的描述正確？
stemLines: Which statement about whole life insurance is correct?
下列哪項關於終身壽險的描述正確？

options.text:
It pays a fixed-term survival benefit at a stated maturity date
A 在指定到期日支付固定年期生存利益

It provides no cash value under level premium designs
B 均衡保費設計下沒有現金價值

It is identical to a pure endowment
C 與純生存保險完全相同

It covers death whenever it occurs, with no fixed maturity survival payout
D 保障任何時候死亡，沒有固定年期生存給付

questions.explanation: 終身壽險提供終身死亡保障，保額於死亡後支付；若有死亡或期滿兩種給付，應辨認為儲蓄壽險。

questions.stem:
An immediate annuity typically involves:
即期年金通常涉及：
stemLines: An immediate annuity typically involves:
即期年金通常涉及：

options.text:
Contributions for at least 20 years before any payment
A 至少供款 20 年後才開始支付

Payments that stop immediately if the annuitant dies on day one
B 年金標的人首日死亡即停止一切支付

Tax deduction without meeting QDAP criteria
C 毋須符合 QDAP 準則亦可扣稅

A single premium with payments starting shortly after issue
D 整付保費並於短期後開始支付

questions.explanation: 即期年金通常以整付保費投保，短期後（常為一個年金期）開始周期支付；延期年金則至指定日期才起付。

questions.stem:
Which combination correctly matches product and typical cash value feature?
下列哪組產品與典型現金價值特徵配對正確？
stemLines: Which combination correctly matches product and typical cash value feature?
下列哪組產品與典型現金價值特徵配對正確？

options.text:
Term insurance — substantial guaranteed cash value
A 定期壽險——大量保證現金價值

Term insurance — mandatory reversionary bonus
B 定期壽險——強制復歸紅利

Whole life — never accumulates cash value
C 終身壽險——永不累積現金價值

Endowment insurance — usually has cash value
D 儲蓄壽險——通常有現金價值

questions.explanation: 定期壽險通常無現金價值；儲蓄及終身壽險使用均衡保費並累積現金價值。

questions.stem:
Term insurance is also known as:

stemLines: Term insurance is also known as:
定期壽險又稱為：

options.text:
Temporary life insurance
A 短期人壽保險

Permanent life insurance
B 永久人壽保險

Life income annuity
C 終身收益年金

Deferred annuity
D 延期年金

questions.explanation: 定期壽險只在特定期間提供保障，因此又稱短期人壽保險；保障事件為指定期間內死亡。

questions.stem:

stemLines: Which situation may cause a Universal Life policy to lapse?
下列哪種情況可能導致萬用壽險保單失效？

options.text:
Excess premium always automatically increases cash value forever
A 過量保費必然令現金價值永遠增加

The policyowner receives an annual report
B 保單所有人收到年報

Interest is credited to the policy account
C 保單帳戶獲計入利息

Cash value is exhausted because premiums are insufficient relative to charges
D 保費相對扣費不足而耗盡現金價值

questions.explanation: 萬用壽險靈活不等於無限制；繳費不足、利息下降或扣費上升可令現金價值耗盡而失效。

questions.stem:
Unit-linked policy benefits are generally:

stemLines: Unit-linked policy benefits are generally:
單位相連保單利益一般：

options.text:
Fixed and guaranteed at inception regardless of markets
A 不論市場於生效時固定保證

Not fixed and fluctuate with chosen investment performance
B 並非固定，隨所選投資表現波動

Capped at the original sum insured with no downside
C 以上限為原保額且沒有下行風險

Payable only on policy maturity, never on death
D 只在期滿支付，身故不賠

questions.explanation: 教材指出單位相連利益不是固定、沒有必然最低保證，須以實際條款及投資表現為準。

questions.stem:
Under an annuity certain for a stated period, payments will:

stemLines: Under an annuity certain for a stated period, payments will:
在規定年期的確定年金下，年金支付將：

options.text:
Stop immediately upon any hospitalisation
A 一旦住院即停止

Be made only while the annuitant remains employed
B 僅在年金標的人受僱期間支付

Require proof of insurable interest at each payment
C 每次支付均須證明可保權益

Continue for the full stated period even if the annuitant dies early
D 即使年金標的人提早死亡，仍須支付至整個規定年期

questions.explanation: 確定年金在規定年期内支付，不論年金標的人是否已死亡；確定期間終身年金則結合終身與最低保證期。

questions.stem:

options.text:
A higher monthly payment than a man because of shorter life expectancy
A 因預期壽命較短而每月較高

The same payment regardless of gender
B 不論性別相同金額

No payments until age 65
C 至 65 歲才支付

A lower periodic benefit than a man because of longer life expectancy
D 因預期壽命較長而每期利益較低

questions.explanation: 女性平均壽命通常較長，相同資本下預期支付期較長，故每期年金通常較低；開始年齡越高則每期越高。

questions.stem:

options.text:
Transfer the master contract to a competitor insurer without notice

Convert group cover to an individual policy within a time limit, often without new evidence of insurability
B 在限期內把團體保障轉為個人保單，通常毋須新可保性證明

Automatically increase sum insured without underwriting
C 自動加保而毋須核保

Assign premium payment obligations to the insurer
D 把繳費責任轉予保險人

questions.explanation: 轉換性容許在指定期限內把團體保障轉為個人保單，通常毋須提供可保性證明，以防保障中斷。

questions.stem:
A Graded-Premium whole life policy is characterised by:
等級保費終身壽險的特點是：

options.text:
Graded-Premium whole life policy is characterised by:
等級保費終身壽險的特點是：
A Level premiums from the first year with no future increases

Premiums that decrease every year as mortality rises
B 隨死亡率上升而每年遞減保費

Single premium payment only

Premiums that start lower and increase periodically until reaching the level needed for the remaining period
D 初期保費較低，之後定期增加直至達餘下保險期所需均衡水平

questions.stem:

Hong Kong Monetary Authority

Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation Limited's wholly-owned subsidiary

questions.stem:

stemLines: For which product is a claim inevitable assuming the policy remains in force until a defined event?
哪種產品在保單維持有效至特定事件時，索償必然發生？

Universal life if no death ever occurs

questions.stem:
